paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Paragraph retrieval ratios 0.90\% of LLMs. The majority of LLMs can be classified as either conservative (ratio<300.90{%}) or open retrievers (ratio>380.90{%}).

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates paragraph retrieval ratios (in percent) for an “Expert” reference and a set of large language models, with one bar per system. The horizontal axis contains the category labels (model names) arranged left to right as: Expert, GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek V3, Qwen2-Max, and GLM-4-Plus; labels are diagonally rotated, and the “Expert” tick label is visually emphasized in red italic text. The vertical axis is labeled “Retrieval Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 0 to 50, with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). Each bar is rendered in a distinct muted color (various grays/teals/blues/purples/beiges), and each has its value printed above it: Expert is 34.11; GPT-4o is 29.07; GPT-4-turbo is 29.16; GPT-4o-mini is 43.57; Claude 3 Opus is 25.92; Claude 3.5 Sonnet is 31.56; Claude 3.5 Haiku is 28.49; Gemini 1.5 Pro is 39.37; Llama-3.1-405B is 37.99; Mistral Large is 31.04; DeepSeek V3 is 46.94; Qwen2-Max is 34.84; and GLM-4-Plus is 43.58. The shortest bar is Claude 3 Opus at 25.92, and the tallest bar is DeepSeek V3 at 46.94; the bars are not displayed as grouped or stacked and do not appear to be sorted by value.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates paragraph retrieval ratios for an “Expert” reference and a set of large language models, with each bar representing a single system’s retrieval ratio. The category axis is the horizontal (x) axis, showing the systems in the displayed order: Expert, GPT‑4o, GPT‑4‑turbo, GPT‑4o‑mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama‑3.1‑405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek V3, Qwen2‑Max, and GLM‑4‑Plus; the “Expert” tick label is visually emphasized in red italics while the others appear in standard dark text. The value axis is the vertical (y) axis labeled “Retrieval Ratio (%)”, using a linear scale spanning 0 to 50 with evenly spaced tick marks at 10‑point intervals. Each bar is a distinct solid color (various muted/pastel tones) and has its exact value printed above it: Expert (dark gray) 34.11, GPT‑4o (greenish) 29.07, GPT‑4‑turbo (purple) 29.16, GPT‑4o‑mini (blue) 43.57, Claude 3 Opus (mauve) 25.92, Claude 3.5 Sonnet (light blue‑gray) 31.56, Claude 3.5 Haiku (tan) 28.49, Gemini 1.5 Pro (light blue) 39.37, Llama‑3.1‑405B (lavender) 37.99, Mistral Large (beige) 31.04, DeepSeek V3 (light gray) 46.94, Qwen2‑Max (very light olive/gray) 34.84, and GLM‑4‑Plus (pale pink) 43.58; the smallest labeled bar is Claude 3 Opus at 25.92 and the tallest is DeepSeek V3 at 46.94. There is no stacking or within-category grouping, no legend, and the bars do not appear to be sorted by value.
